snippet.title: PIXEL COMBAT - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Pixel Combat is a pixel shooter where you have to fight for survival in a world plagued by zombie apocalypse. Defend your home from waves of zombies, build a time machine and fight unique bosses. Crafting, upgrades and a nostalgic atmosphere.
